product.title: Notre-Dame Exterior & Sainte-Chapelle Medieval Paris Tour

description.text: In Paris, this half-day tour lets you discover a handful of top sights in just several hours with skip-the-line access. Tour Conciergerie and Sainte-Chapelle with a guide, and head inside the newly restored Notre Dame Cathedral. Stops include Equestrian Statue of Henri IV, Conciergerie, Sainte-Chapelle, Notre-Dame Cathedral of Paris, Seine River. Bonus: A flexible Seine River cruise ticket is included. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Equestrian Statue of Henri IV, Conciergerie, Sainte-Chapelle, Notre-Dame Cathedral of Paris that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
